evidence.observation: O2 at growth onset ~1.7 ppm, consistent with well-purged tube
O2 rises monotonically 1.7→6.5→12.2→18.7→20.7→25.3 ppm through growth, indicating progressive air ingress
Temperature holds 750 °C, heater power and Ar flow steady and nominal — thermal and gas delivery appear normal
Pressure gauge not installed (null), so leak cannot be corroborated by pressure

args.missing_evidence: A leak-rate check (e.g., isolate/step Ar flow and watch O2 response) or an installed pressure gauge trace; the O2 trend alone already indicates ingress but cannot localize the leak.
